Welcoming vibe and full of surprises
Sep 2024 • Couples
Pizza 4P’s Vo Van Kiet is a true hidden gem. While I've enjoyed their Ben Thanh branch, this location is truly special. The atmosphere is incredibly relaxing and perfect for a casual meal with friends, family, or a romantic date. The restaurant is spotless, and the staff is incredibly attentive and friendly, going above and beyond to ensure a pleasant dining experience.

They even helped me with a surprise for my husband on our anniversary, adding a sweet message to our dessert plate. It was a lovely touch!

The food is delicious and surprisingly affordable. While the dishes themselves are generally on the milder side, they provide a selection of condiments to customize your meal to your liking. I particularly enjoyed the crab pasta, which was even better with a dash of chili oil.

While there were a few flies buzzing around, it didn't detract too much from the overall experience.

Overall, Pizza 4P’s Vo Van Thanh is a great option for a delicious and affordable meal in a relaxing setting. I highly recommend it, especially for those looking for a personalized touch and the option to customize their dishes.

The best pizza in HCMC!
Dec 2019
Pizza 4P is a full service Italian restaurant with an extensive menu but without the pretentiousness or unreasonable pricing of some of these places. I'd recommend prioritizing the Pizza and the fondue over the starters or Pasta! Service is prompt and the Pizzas are made fresh right in front of you at their oven which makes sure a great aroma fills the restaurant. They also have a decent wine menu with offerings from as far as Chile! Expect to pay around 300,000 VND pp without drinks.
